name: Ras el Hanout
description: A warm, complex North African spice blend. The name means 'head of the shop' — the best the spice merchant has to offer.
recipeInstructions: Toast cumin seeds, coriander seeds, and cardamom pods in a dry pan over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Let cool.
Grind toasted spices in a spice grinder or mortar until fine.
Combine with paprika, cinnamon, turmeric, ginger, pepper, cayenne, allspice, nutmeg, and cloves. Mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight jar away from heat and light. Best used within 3 months.
